evals.prompt: 处理 LUC-123；它的描述决定验收条件，先建立分支。
evals.expected_output: Loads composio-tool-router, discovers only Linear tools needed to read LUC-123, reconciles acceptance criteria, and resolves the project's PR base from repository evidence rather than assuming origin/dev or Linear MCP.

evals.prompt: 功能已经合并，用户已授权本任务完成后自动关闭 LUC-123。
evals.expected_output: Delegates a bounded OpenCode post-delivery closure through Composio CLI with exact issue/action scope, dry run, child/acceptance readback, and one compact PR/test summary; it does not use Linear MCP or make unrelated writes.

evals.prompt: Composio 没有连接，但代码已验证并可以开 PR。
evals.expected_output: Reports the unavailable Linear integration and continues the core delivery path; it does not block coding, PR work, or fabricate a Linear update.

evals.prompt: LUC-123 已 merge，关闭父 issue。它还有两个子 issue。
evals.expected_output: Reads the parent and required children through Composio, refuses closure when required children or acceptance criteria remain incomplete, and reports the exact next action.
